```ruby title="Ruby"

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><aside class="sidebar"><h2>Related</h2><p>Sidebar text</p></aside><main><p>Main text</p></main></body>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['.sidebar']))
```
